# LatentScore

> Open-source local procedural ambient music synthesizer and reactive mood engine for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and web browsers. Zero GPU required.

LatentScore turns short text prompts (such as "quiet morning desk" or "rainy midnight coffee shop") into calm, seamless procedural ambient soundscapes locally on CPU. It pairs LLM-distilled retrieval across 14,035 curated moods with an interpretable 34-field procedural DSP synthesizer.

## Links

- Homepage: https://latentscore.com/
- Live Browser Studio (zero backend, runs locally in WebAssembly): https://latentscore.com/demo
- Source Repository (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/prabal-rje/latentscore
- Python Package (PyPI): https://pypi.org/project/latentscore/
- JavaScript / TypeScript Package (npm): https://www.npmjs.com/package/latentscore
- Rust Crate (crates.io): https://crates.io/crates/latentscore
- Google Colab Quickstart: https://colab.research.google.com/github/prabal-rje/latentscore/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart-colab.ipynb
- Research Writeup: https://prabal.ca/posts/latentscore-research/

## Quickstart by Language

### Python

```bash
pip install latentscore
```

```python
import time
import latentscore as ls

# One-shot render and playback
ls.render("morning coffee shop").play()

# Reactive live steering for local apps
with ls.Score("quiet morning desk", glide_seconds=3.5).play() as score:
    time.sleep(6)
    score.steer("rainy midnight coffee shop")
    time.sleep(6)
    score.drift()
    time.sleep(6)
```

### JavaScript and TypeScript (Browser, Node.js, Bun, Deno)

Zero runtime dependencies. Dual ESM and CJS exports.

```bash
npm install latentscore
```

```ts
import { createBrowserScore } from "latentscore/browser";

const music = createBrowserScore("quiet morning desk", { glideSeconds: 3.5 });
playButton.addEventListener("click", () => music.play());
editor.addEventListener("input", () => music.steerOnType(editor.value));
```

### Rust

Pure Rust synthesizer with optional lock-free `cpal` live audio playback.

```toml
[dependencies]
latentscore = { version = "0.1", features = ["playback"] }
```

```rust
use latentscore::Score;

let handle = Score::from_text("quiet morning desk")
    .with_glide_seconds(3.5)
    .play()?;
handle.steer("rainy midnight coffee shop");
```
